lines.text: and what you hold of each.
No account. No upload. No wait.

notes.order: The screens arrive in the order you would actually reach them in the app — home, a reciter, the coverage wheel, the player — so the transitions are navigation rather than a slideshow.
notes.folder: The filenames in the opening beat are invented, and deliberately the kind you really end up with: a date-stamped WhatsApp export, a FINAL(2), a bare track07. They are the problem stated as evidence rather than as a claim.
notes.claim: The last line is the one place the local-first promise is stated, and it is stated as a consequence — what it gets you — rather than as architecture.
notes.copy: Two lines were rewritten after seeing them set: "They file themselves by juz." was orphaning "juz." at the display size, and the local-first line ran to four ragged lines with an em dash stranded on one of them. The claim is now three short sentences and a four-word payoff.
